show.description: A childhood act of bravery connects Krish and Sana, but fate separates them. Years later, a forced contract marriage, misunderstandings, and conspiracies pull them back together. Through betrayal, danger, and emotional turmoil, Krish realizes Saniya is the girl he has been searching for all along—and love finally triumphs over every contract and condition.
